title: Proper forget-supports normalizes the diagonal section on one scheme
statement: Let $A$ be a finite commutative ring, $f:X\to S$ proper, and $p=p_a:X\times_S X\to X$ either projection. Let $d:X\to X\times_S X$ be the diagonal and use the data of [def-sf-p1-integral-transport-data]. Write $U_X$ for the derived tensor unit, $C_X=A_X[0]$, $c:C_X\cong U_X$ for constantUnit, and $s_a:U_X\to Rp_!Rd_!U_X$ for diagonalUnit. Let $\phi_h:Rh_!\cong Rh_*$ be proper forget-supports [def-sp-unbounded-proper-shriek-star-comparison], and $\eta_h$ the constant-object unit of [def-asd-ordinary-supported-kummer-system]. For every $K\in D(X_{et},A)$ and $\theta:U_X\to K$, one has $s_a;Rp_!(\phi_{d,U_X}.\mathrm{hom};Rd_*(\theta));\phi_{p,Rd_*K}.\mathrm{hom}=c^{-1};\eta_p;Rp_*(\eta_d);Rp_*Rd_*(c.\mathrm{hom};\theta)$. This is a normalization on one self-product, natural in the coefficient map, with no projective-line isomorphism or exchange map. The proper forget-supports isomorphisms are expressed by ordinaryProperForgetComparison [def-sf-ordinary-proper-forget-comparison], which is the same canonical construction with recorded ordinary endpoints.

proof.text: Use ordinaryProperForgetComparison, the existing canonical proper forget-supports isomorphism with its ordinary endpoint fixed. Expand the specified compact-support compositor in its compatible tower: the chosen compactification of p, and the compactification of d followed by its open immersion obtained by ofComp from the chosen compactification of d p. Its maps are proper/open exchange, open-extension composition, and proper direct-image composition. Substitute the adjunction-mate definition of exchange. Naturality of open-extension-to-direct-image maps and the mate counit identity show that the two forget-supports maps convert this tower compositor to the ordinary direct-image compositor. Apply rightDerivedLowerShriekOfCompactificationIso_hom_app_comp_toLowerStar (CompactificationRefinementLowerStar) to the model comparisons at d and d p. Equivalently the resulting equality can be computed with identity compactifications. The identity comparison is explicitly forget-supports followed by the ordinary identity comparison.

As d followed by p is identity, the inverse ordinary identity/composition map on the constant object equals the composite of its two constant-object units: the adjunction composition-unit formula and composition coherence of constant-sheaf pullback identify the composite with the identity-map unit, which is identity. Naturality moves c inverse to the source. Use diagonal_fst and diagonal_snd in the respective Boolean cases. Empty schemes and the zero ring obey the same identities.

For an arbitrary coefficient object K and map theta from the tensor unit, postcompose the constant-object normalization with Rp_* Rd_* of c.hom followed by theta. Naturality of proper forget-supports moves this map inside the two compactly supported direct images. Functoriality and c.inv followed by c.hom equals identity leave theta as the intact diagonal coefficient map. This gives the stated natural formula without splitting a composite coefficient map under derived direct image.

theorem diagonalSection_forgetSupports
    (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A] [Finite A]
    {S X : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S) [IsProper f] (a : Bool)
    (K : DerivedCategoryModule A X)
    (θ : derivedTensorUnit (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) X ⟶ K) :
    diagonalUnit A f a ≫
        (rightDerivedLowerShriek (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) (projection f a)).map
          ((ordinaryProperForgetComparison A
              (TraceDiagonalDatum.diagonal f)).hom.app
                (derivedTensorUnit (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) X) ≫
            (ordinaryFinitePushforward A (TraceDiagonalDatum.diagonal f)).map θ) ≫
        (ordinaryProperForgetComparison A
          (projection f a)).hom.app
            ((ordinaryFinitePushforward A (TraceDiagonalDatum.diagonal f)).obj K) =
      (constantUnit A X).inv ≫ supportedDerivedUnit A (projection f a) ≫
        (ordinaryFinitePushforward A (projection f a)).map
          (supportedDerivedUnit A (TraceDiagonalDatum.diagonal f)) ≫
        (ordinaryFinitePushforward A (projection f a)).map
          ((ordinaryFinitePushforward A (TraceDiagonalDatum.diagonal f)).map
            ((constantUnit A X).hom ≫ θ))
